paras: Anolis kreutzi is a species of lizard in the family Dactyloidae. The species is endemic to Honduras.
The specific name, kreutzi, is in honor of scientific illustrator Jörg Kreutz.
A. kreutzi is found in northwestern Honduras in Atlántida Department and Yoro Department.
The preferred natural habitat of A. kreutzi is forest, at altitudes of 1,030–1,690 m (3,380–5,540 ft).
A. kreutzi is arboreal and diurnal.
